scope: Archived systems seeds only. Missing-comparison questions audit old claims; they are not new hypotheses or novelty grades.
rejection_semantics: Excluded from intellectual center does not mean false; retired does not guarantee a mechanism-preserving descendant.
evidence_limits: Most generation-one records identify prior-art families without an exact source match. This audit does not claim an exhaustive or updated literature search.

seeds.name: Memory portability can export mistakes
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Moving a personal profile between agents can preserve unsupported beliefs more efficiently than local reset.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.strongest_objection: Data quality rather than new concept.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Profile export -> reuse by successor agents -> persistence of unsupported beliefs; compare local reset and provenance-aware transfer.
seeds.missing_comparison: Does the inspected closest portability/data-quality work establish propagation across agent handoffs on downstream action quality and authority, with the same reset/validation intervention?

seeds.name: Assistance portability benchmark
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Users can compare providers by post-transfer performance and mandate integrity.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: Portability benchmark can test both state quality and mandate integrity.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: Portability benchmark can test both state quality and mandate integrity.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Provider transfer -> retained functional performance and mandate integrity, rather than export success alone.
seeds.missing_comparison: Compare the old benchmark objectives together against existing transfer benchmarks; I164 retains typed contrast but has no provider transfer or performance endpoint.

seeds.name: Mandate interoperability
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Permission semantics may become a public infrastructure problem when agents negotiate across institutions.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Equivalent scopes across providers/institutions -> preservation or change of action semantics.
seeds.missing_comparison: Does an existing interoperability implementation preserve operation, purpose, recipient, budget and jurisdiction together? Compare semantic containment across providers, not merely token serialization.

seeds.name: International mandate mismatch
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Authority valid in one jurisdiction can be invalid when an agent acts through another.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.missing_comparison: A jurisdiction-specific closest source and executed cross-border workflow are absent; compare exact action/resource/purpose bounds and which institutional check changes the outcome.

seeds.name: Agent density norm shift
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Small coordination advantages can make unaided participation impractical once most counterparties use agents.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Agent adoption share -> coordination advantage -> unaided participation feasibility.
seeds.missing_comparison: Compare adoption-threshold models on feasible unaided participation rather than adoption or utility alone, with response windows and manual-channel institutions allowed to respond.

seeds.name: Coordination affordance debt
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Agent-optimized spaces can lose affordances required by people without agents.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Agent-oriented redesign -> loss of unaided affordances -> participation outcomes.
seeds.missing_comparison: Locate a closest design/automation composition using the same affordance-loss endpoint and compare retained unaided channels to agent provision; no such exact comparison is recorded.

seeds.name: Automation exit externality
seeds.exact_old_proposition: One institution’s automation can raise exit costs for unaided users of other institutions.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.missing_comparison: Test the old cross-institution dependency model against a source with the same cross-boundary exit outcome, holding own-provider switching cost separate. No graph-level equivalence is documented.

seeds.name: Negotiation time asymmetry

seeds.name: Legitimacy bandwidth
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Authority can be limited by how many decisions can be meaningfully reviewed over time.

seeds.name: Democratic attention scarcity

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Cheaper policy generation -> proposal arrival -> finite public deliberation capacity.
seeds.missing_comparison: Does a closest model predict the same effective deliberation endpoint when proposal production and review cost adapt? Compare maintained review capacity and generation/traffic policies rather than merely more user assistance.

seeds.name: Human control can be vendor control

seeds.name: Consensus by common inference
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Independent-looking agents can generate correlated advice because they share models and memory infrastructure.

seeds.name: Common provider recovery cliff
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Individually manageable dependencies can become unrecoverable when many fail simultaneously.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: Aggregate exit feasibility under correlated outages may expose a system-level threshold.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: Aggregate exit feasibility under correlated outages may expose a system-level threshold.

seeds.known_parts: Systemic risk, common-mode failure and shared recovery capacity.
seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Correlated outage -> simultaneous fallback demand -> scarce restoration resources -> aggregate recovery feasibility.
seeds.missing_comparison: Compare same local utility/reliability and dependency distributions against an interdependent-network/recovery-capacity model; I166 is excluded as a separate agenda without an executed threshold comparison.

seeds.name: Correlated exit cliff
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Equal immediate utility can mask collective inability to recover from common provider outage.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: Network resilience precedent; separate research agenda.
precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: Network resilience precedent; separate research agenda.

seeds.known_parts: Network resilience; generation-two ledger mechanically selects Bainbridge as first cited source.
seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Equal immediate utility -> common provider outage -> collective recovery inability.
seeds.missing_comparison: The closest-source field does not establish same network graph or shared recovery outcome. Compare network resilience and recovery-capacity sources before classifying this composition as equivalent.

seeds.name: Apprenticeship bottleneck

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.ledger_review_note: No demonstrated irreducible novelty; retain as a background observation or testable supporting hypothesis.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Automated novice tasks -> future expert supply -> exceptional-case supervision.

seeds.name: Externalized institutional memory

seeds.name: Perfect buyer versus perfect seller

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Purchasing agents versus persuasion agents -> competition over preference formation rather than price alone.
seeds.missing_comparison: Locate a closest equilibrium with the same preference-shaping control, counterpart information, outside options and welfare outcome. The held seed was retired without a generation-two descendant or equilibrium test.

seeds.name: Preference model ecology
seeds.exact_old_proposition: Multiple systems jointly shape a person whose preferences each system models as external.

seeds.old_composition_and_outcome: Multiple agents -> shared evolving preference state -> individually external-looking evidence.
seeds.missing_comparison: Compare a closest multiple-controller graph on attribution and interference, not only single-agent policy sensitivity; no descendants preserve this held seed in generation two.

seeds.exact_old_proposition: Institutional service renewals may use success measures affected by the provider’s own choice architecture.

precise_old_rejection_or_retirement.selection_reason: Metrics and principal-agent incentives already cover broad claim.
